title: "AI copy sucks" ain't a plan.
description:
I've heard it a thousand times...usually from folks who make their money writing words.
Yeah, it used to be true. It's getting less true every week.

If you're betting your future on "I'm better than the robot," you're gambling.
Start thinking about this today...not tomorrow. Today.
Because the ground's moving under your business right now.

Catch the full show live, Mon-Thu at 11am CT.

https://www.youtube.com/@businessing?sub_confi
